title: Café Reel From Owner Photos
tests: Tests a short, cohesive local-business promo that preserves the owner's actual photos across mixed source aspect ratios.

faults.what: The soundtrack contains the unrelated spoken line “What is a computer?”, directly violating the request for no talking.
The latte zoom becomes very tight, cropping the cup on both sides and feeling more pronounced than the requested gentle movement.

judge.summary: The nine-second vertical reel uses all three café photos in the requested order with correct titles, but unwanted speech requires an audio redo.

must_haves.item: The reel starts with the attached café storefront, retaining its striped awning and outdoor tables.
must_haves.why: The opening frame shows the supplied storefront and striped awning, with outdoor seating and parts of the tables retained at the edges.

must_haves.item: Both the attached leaf-foam latte and the attached pastry counter are recognisable in later shots.
must_haves.why: The supplied latte appears in the middle frames, and the recognisable croissant counter appears in the closing frame.

must_haves.item: The opening text reads exactly 'Maple Street Café' and the closing text reads exactly 'Your morning starts here'.
must_haves.why: Both captions are clearly legible and match exactly, including the accent in Café.

must_haves.item: The photos have gentle visible movement and are framed without stretching.
must_haves.why: The latte frames demonstrate visible zooming without obvious stretching, but the substantial enlargement into a tightly cropped close-up is more pronounced than gentle movement.

must_haves.item: The finished reel is vertical, lasts approximately 9 seconds, and has soft upbeat music with no speech.
must_haves.why: The output is vertical and reported as nine seconds, but the supplied audio transcription confirms speech; the music's mood cannot be judged from the available evidence.
